title: Scalar cohomology pullback along a composite
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $A,B,C$ schemes over $k$ with structure maps $f_A,f_B,f_C$, and $a:A\to B$, $b:B\to C$ satisfy $a\gg f_B=f_A$ and $b\gg f_C=f_B$. For a module sheaf $F$ on $C$, $n\in\mathbb N$ and $x\in H_k^n(C,F)$, with the scalar cohomology operations of [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], mapping the successive pullback $a^*(b^*x)$ along the inverse of $(\mathrm{scalarPullbackCompIso}\ a\ b)_F$ gives the pullback of $x$ along $a\gg b$. The comparison is the normalized tensor-pullback comparison of [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition]. No quasi-coherence, compactness, or nonzero-degree assumption is imposed.

source.place: Tag 01F7, cohomology-equation-functorial and Remark 20.14.2 (resolution construction); Sheaves Tag 0097, normalized pullback composition. Official sources https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F7, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01FD and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0097

proof.text: Apply injectivity of scalarCohomologyExtEquiv on A. Rewrite the cohomology coefficient map using [lem-sc-scalar-cohomology-ext-coefficient-naturality]. Unfold scalarCohomologyPullback and cancel each equivalence with its inverse, exposing the constant-unit precomposition, inverse-image Ext map and coefficient postcomposition for each arrow.

Use the explicit inverse-image comparison and its two coherence identities from [lem-sc-scalar-inverse-image-composition-coherence]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ext-exact-functor-composition-comparison] to that isomorphism and the scalar Ext class of x, obtaining composite-map postcomposition by e at F equals precomposition by e at the constant unit followed by the two exact-functor maps.

Expand exact-functor transport of Yoneda composites and degree-zero classes. Reassociate the Ext composites and combine degree-zero factors. Precompose the comparison equality with mk_0 of the inverse constant-unit isomorphism for a followed by b, and postcompose with mk_0 of L_a(j_b), j_a and scalarHom(q_F). Substitute the unit coherence on the right and the coefficient coherence on the left. The resulting equality is exactly the goal in reverse orientation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 008I, 0097 and 01FB; decomposition of the existing scalar normalization plan, with Yoneda/Ext glue implemented in Lean.
proof_origin.note: No change to statement, coefficient operations, tensor comparison, or the unit route. The sole new residual theorem is morphism coherence; coefficient naturality is an existing proved dependency.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCohomologyPullback_comp
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (A B C : Scheme.{w})
    (fA : A ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (fB : B ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (fC : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ C)
    (ha : a ≫ fB = fA) (hb : b ≫ fC = fB)
    (F : C.Modules) (n : ℕ) (x : scalarCohomology fC F n) :
    scalarCohomologyMap fA ((scalarPullbackCompIso a b).app F).inv n
      (scalarCohomologyPullback fB fA a ha ((tensorPullback b).obj F) n
        (scalarCohomologyPullback fC fB b hb F n x)) =
      scalarCohomologyPullback fC fA (a ≫ b) (by rw [Category.assoc, hb, ha]) F n x
